Before I can approve and release it, I'll need to hear from our equity liaison and safeguarding coordinator with their operational reports. Let's walk through the current draft -- it accepts self-taped auditions, uses ten-minute prepared sides, and currently doesn't specify an audition fee or any special minor-participant procedure. What do your reports show?

So our current draft is out of compliance on two fronts: the ten-minute sides exceed the five-minute limit, and no audition fee is specified.
